excerpt.rendered: Florida Poodle Rescue invites you to Join the Generosity Movement!   Our goal for #GivingTuesday 2023 is to raise $35,000 for our rescue. Thank you for all of your support!

meta._et_pb_old_content:
Join The Generosity Movement! #GivingTuesday is an annual day of giving that occurs on the first Tuesday after Thanksgiving. #GivingTuesday has been a rousing success over the past several years. This year #GivingTuesday is on November 28, 2023.  Give generously to help our rescued Poodles!
